text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's summer, and preparations for the autumn Tenno Sho are underway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen is more focused than ever, determined to achieve the feat of successive wins in both the spring and autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Filled to the brim with motivation, she begins her final summer camp!
